activity_summary: After the meal, and before church, your feet went into a basin of salt water. Anne told you to sit. You sat.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Sat, and stayed in the basin.

entities.name: Anne Shakespeare
entities.context: Salted the water and left you in it.

entities.name: Joan Shakespeare
entities.context: Told you to leave the feet in the salt.

facets.activity: Put the feet in salt water

quotes.speaker: anne_shakespeare
quotes.text: Feet in. The water is salt
